notes.title: v0.3.3 day one patch
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Now, when upgrading weapons, the correct amount of gold is taken.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a game crash when activating the Redmoon technique on weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Steam achievement Religious II was earned together with the Hunter II achievement.[/p][/*][*][p]The health of summoned creatures has been reduced.[/p][/*][*][p]A restriction has been added for loading saves from the demo version.[/p][/*][*][p]\[EN] The description of the Magic Trap technique has been corrected.[/p][/*][*][p]Two screen resolutions have been added for small screen formats.[/p][/*][*][p]The description of enchantments related to melee weapons has been corrected.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a game crash when playing with the Stone Barrier rune.[/p][/*][*][p]The placement of locations on the island map has been corrected for large islands.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Blood Potion allowed you to kill ordinary enemies almost guaranteed.[/p][/*][/list]
